scope: Read-only ordinary functional startup input retention. No resources created or changed.
limitations: Only exact fetched real startup entry was delayed, then released unchanged; no API response rewriting.
Project control had no field during the captured pre-handler window; empty samples are not retention evidence. A separate later ready control retained typing.
Census counts direct JSX sites, not runtime instances; wrapper callers need expansion.
Screenshots are ignored supplementary evidence; complete DOM receipts below are the durable handoff.
